no_previous_rule: A Window with no previous Step Pair (absent or dropped) gets an all-zero mask for the Previous-Target Floor.
caveats: Caption leak: Gemma wrote the Caption (goal, subgoal, action) while looking at frames 1 to 10 of the Window, so the Caption can describe the change that the model is asked to draw. A strong Caption-only result is therefore not evidence that a Caption written before the fact would help.

LPIPS caveat: LPIPS was trained on natural images. On white rectangles on black it mostly measures where edges and blobs are. These scores are image-similarity scores of Grid Maps and are not comparable with the box-based scores of DiT2VLM.
